The app won't accept the contact, and nothing was saved. It objects to the **Email** field (`jane.doe@`).

- **Other fields:** First name (Jane), Last name (Doe), Company (AutoZone, Inc.) and Status (Imported lead) were all accepted. None of them was flagged.
- **Cleanup:** I clicked Cancel to close the form. The new contact never reached the list, and I didn't change the email.
